purpose: Human-reviewable plan consumed by Scripts/release_import_shulchan.py: native OBJ import of the seven original ShulchanV2 parts, gold material on every slot (bread material on the loaves), GeometryScript winding check with conditional flip, removal of the crude REVIEW_HeikhalKeilim_SM_ShulchanStudy box and placement of the RELEASE_Shulchan_* assembly at the same origin in the combined map. Every number below is read from the frozen geometry manifest or receipts; nothing here claims visual acceptance.
lastKnownMapSha256Note: Walkthrough.umap on disk when this spec was prepared (after the keruv frieze placement). Recorded as matched/not matched only, not a guard.
collisionNote: All parts NoCollision like the other release vessels (the Heikhal is not on the visitor walking route; a bounded review, not a walkable prop).

source.objAdapter: Source OBJ has Y reflected and triangle winding reversed for the legacy OBJ importer (create_shulchan_v2.write_obj, same as the keilim/doors/reliefs adapter). The importer reflects Y back, so the imported StaticMesh must reproduce canonicalBoundsCm (local +Y = room side = south at yaw 0) and UE signed volumes must be positive. Every part shares the bottom-centre pivot on the floor under the table centre, so all seven actors take the same transform.

importSettings.note: Identical to the reviewed keilim/keruvim/reliefs/doors/vessels OBJ adapter path (FbxFactory). Single-mesh OBJ: destination_name is the exact mesh name.

materials.rule: First candidate that exists on disk and loads as a MaterialInterface is assigned to EVERY slot of the mesh (SM_KeruvimStudyV1 lesson). Falling past the first candidate is recorded as a limitation.

bread.candidatesNote: No existing bread-like or neutral matte material was found in Content/ on 2026-09-07 (126 materials surveyed: gold variants, stone/paving, cedar and bench wood with grain, linen, Kotel tints). Wood-grain and linen were rejected as misleading on bread, so the loaves get a created constant material.
bread.method: EditorAssetSubsystem.duplicate_asset(duplicateFrom -> createPath), then new Constant3Vector/Constant expressions wired to BaseColor/Metallic/Roughness (connect_material_property replaces the gold inputs; the orphaned gold constants stay unconnected). Fallback: MaterialFactoryNew with the same recipe as create_heikhal_keilim.run_native. Recorded in the receipt.

constants.note: warm matte crust tone; artistic real-time choice

windingCheck.note: GeometryScript readback of the imported LOD0 source model (needs -EnablePlugins=GeometryScripting): bulk vertex/triangle lists, signed volume by the divergence theorem with UE left-handed face normal cross(C-A, B-A), a sample cross-checked against get_triangle_face_normal (disagreements must be 0). Falls back to the per-triangle loop. Negative volume -> triangle order reversed with append_buffers_to_mesh and written back with copy_mesh_to_static_mesh, re-saved, re-checked, recorded.
windingCheck.expectedOfflineRightHandedVolumeSign: positive for all seven files (create_shulchan_v2 readback: the Y reflection and the winding reversal each flip the sign once), so no flip is expected; the flip path exists for safety.

removal.note: The crude 100 x 50 x 76 cm box study is destroyed in memory AFTER the .umap checkpoint and only persists as removed when the level is saved at the end; its label, folder, mesh, pose and world bounds are recorded. The run refuses if it is not found exactly once with this mesh and pose (keilim-move-20260907T171347Z.json / keilim-scale-20260907T171503Z.json readback).
removal.label: REVIEW_HeikhalKeilim_SM_ShulchanStudy
removal.assetsLeftInPlace: SM_ShulchanStudy and M_HeikhalKeilim_Gold stay in HeikhalKeilimV1 (the altar study still uses the gold material).

placement.axes: X east; Y south; Z up; the table stands at the north side of the Heikhal, local +Y (room side) = south.
placement.originBasis: Book pp. 241, 250: table centre 2.5 amot (125 cm) from the north wall face Y -500 measured to the table edge (reading A of book-keilim-review: -500 + 125 + 25 = -350) and 5 amot from the west wall X -5600 (-5600 + 250 + 50 = -5300); length along the House (east-west) = yaw 0. Same origin as the study it replaces.
placement.supportsSide: north and south LONG sides, one plate per stack per side; rods run north-south. Basis: book p. 250 diagram 22:17 shows the two 5-tefach plates side by side face-on with the 2-tefach gap and the rod ends as dots; TI showbread table columns stand in pairs at the long sides. The alternative in the brief (short ends) was checked and rejected.

northWall.rule: Every placed part AABB must keep min Y >= faceY + minClearanceCm (2 amot; Rashi Shemos 26:35 passage). By the manifest the full assembly reaches Y -388.9 (111.1 cm clearance); if any part violates the guard it and its dependants are dropped and the table-only set is placed; recorded.

placement.tableOnlyNote: Fallback set when the supports would violate the wall guard (or -ShulchanTableOnly): the table with its rings, the censers and the two loaf stacks (they rest on the table); snifim and kanim are skipped and recorded.

floor.groundSource: floor component bounds read from the loaded level (traces return nothing in commandlets)

roomEnvelope.rule: Every placed AABB must lie inside the Heikhal envelope.

clearance.rule: Each planned world AABB must not have strictly positive overlap volume with any mesh-bearing actor of the level other than the removed study, the floor, terrain tiles and hollow architecture unions whose verified constituent boxes are not hit (release_place_assets.py rules). A blocker refuses the run BEFORE anything is saved.

verification.compareRule: Numeric location/rotation/scale fields and AABB corners only.

limitations: Original interpretive model: profiles (crenellated zer, misgeret moulding and bosses, tapered legs, plate thickness and stand-off, rod radii, dough thickness, censer shape) are artistic; counts and halachic sizes follow the cited pages (geometry-manifest.json dimensions table).
The 3-amot table height follows the book's main line (p. 241); the alternative reading that 3 amot include the bread (p. 246) is not modelled.
Loaf walls are 2 tefachim (Menachos 96a) with a 7-etzbaot karnot gap (p. 241 diagram 22:6); the brief's 'walls 7 tefachim' was read against the page and not used.
Plates stand at the LONG sides (p. 250 diagram 22:17; TI); the short-end alternative is not modelled.
No carrying poles, no TI ornament (vine band, acanthus brackets), no bread texture; the bread material is a constant colour.
NoCollision on every part; visual acceptance pending.
